notes_for_editor: Record id us-sc-saluda is Saluda County (OSM 357111643, 34.0120, -81.7959). Elevation: OSM gives 168 m, TopoQuest gives 547 ft (about 167 m); the story gives both. No build year, staffing, fire, NHLR or FFLOS listing was found; the story does not claim the tower stands, because the only current sources are map and gazetteer entries. The 1993 closure is system-wide, not tied to this tower in any source. The OSM note about a communication mast is an edit comment on the volunteer map, not a site check; a site visit or an agency answer would settle what is on the site. Did not find a second source for the agency name; the spelling correction rests on the SCFC site. Both search budgets were used; reads reached about the cap.
